## 17:35Z - Align classifyVisualGateReport block-verdict handling with near-miss preview contract

- Work OS `cc5fa9d0-e3da-41a4-82bb-a781adf3d72a`; worktree `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-align-block-verdict`, branch `codex/launchloom-align-block-verdict`, based on `origin/main` (`d19f8e73`).
- Run `46035721545` (**Crestline Electrical**, `#387`, after PR #385) passed creative authoring (6th consecutive pass) AND passed `Render and repair creative candidates in the production shell` (zero pack fallback!) via `attemptNearMissPreview` (which explicitly permits `verdict: "block"` when every finding classifies as `"open"`). One second later, `validate-creative-preview-selection.mjs` rejected the exact same candidate with `"blocked verdict"` because `classifyVisualGateReport` (`scripts/creative-gate-severity.mjs`) only returned `"warned"` for `verdict === "pass" || verdict === "revise"` and hard-rejected `verdict === "block"` even when `hard.length === 0`.
- Fix applied: treat `verdict === "block"` with `hard.length === 0 && warnings.length > 0` as `"warned"` in `classifyVisualGateReport` (still rejecting unexplained empty `block` verdicts with `warnings.length === 0` and any report with hard/critical findings), aligning `validate-creative-preview-selection.mjs` with `run-rendered-creative-repair.mjs`.
- Next: verify tests, open/merge PR, verify deploy, and re-run `#387` to verified creative preview, admin approval, and live client delivery.
